title: LLMs Mirror Country-Specific Gender Patterns If Asked, but Skew Male When Generating Media in Local Languages

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the gender distribution (male vs. female) of protagonists in LLM-generated media for 22 occupational and domestic roles under explicit (direct questioning) versus implicit (media generation) elicitation, and evaluating these outputs against human survey baselines and media representation statistics.

Measuring how the magnitude of gender bias and alignment with local human survey baselines shifts depending on the prompt's language (English vs. local languages like Hindi, Swahili, Hausa, and Yoruba) and country-specific framing (US, India, Kenya, Nigeria).
